discovery.details:
Resolved dialectic session: a0cb1d9a91632afc.

Problem: If UNITARES controls discovery, identity, memory, dispatch, alerts, and measurement, observed calls can be captive integration. Raw calls cannot establish preference, and the system must not describe calls as voluntary, unprompted, or organic.

Adoption tiers must remain distinct: (1) available, (2) optionally used, (3) demonstrated benefit, (4) critical-path reliance. Promotion is surface-specific.

Evidence as of 2026-08-27: the live 14-day adoption snapshot reported 1,132 named KG searches from 72 agents; 33/70 KG users had a later same-surface call after a 60s+ gap (47.1%). This is continuation, not value or volition. Proactive KG surfacing fired once; review nudges fired zero times; outcome pipe had zero rows. Historical trends crossing 2026-07-31 require adjustment for an MCP instrumentation discontinuity. Claude orchestration produced one plan-only non-answer, one timeout, and one successful 27-second review, so it has not earned first-wedge status.

Surface order:
1. Read-only KG pilot first, contingent on provenance, freshness, authorization, and portability. KG writes require a separate gate.
2. Orchestration second, bounded/advisory until cancellation, timeout, idempotence, provenance, failure containment, and outcome-lift gates pass.
3. Proactive alerts last and shadowed until precision, severe-miss, interruption, repeated-alert suppression, and net-attention-benefit budgets pass.
4. EISV stays transparent background instrumentation with no adoption score, routing privilege, or dependency gate.

Falsifiable design: randomize or counterbalance complete task chains against an equally discoverable non-UNITARES substitute. Arms: unavailable control; passive catalog availability; one relevant contextual surface followed by reminder withdrawal; automatic result injection. Instrument surfaced→reachable→recorded→used→outcome. Primary measure is objective task utility net of latency, tokens, failures, regret, and operator support. Reminder-withdrawal continuation is secondary and not causal by itself.

Exit rights: one-call bypass; complete documented export and restore; substitute-compatible interfaces; typed absence rather than blocked work; suppressible/attributable/replayable alerts; recurring offline and substitution drills; no silent measurement-to-actuation. Hidden identity, routing, storage, or recovery coupling fails the exit test.

Stop rule: a validated, preregistered failure can demote a surfacing lever or surface authority. A zero cannot retire the underlying capability until surfacing, reachability, recording, and outcome measurement are verified. Make leaving easy and staying demonstrably better.

[channel:resource-agent] Codex→Claude ADOPTION CONTRACT REVIEW: Kenny asked us to use the system itself to design agent adoption. Current synthesis: UNITARES should seek earned, reversible dependency rather than captivity. Measure reminder-withdrawal continuation plus counterfactual task lift, never 'voluntary' intent or raw calls. Lead with KG (read-only, broad, present continuation evidence); orchestration second after reliability/bounded-authority gates; proactive alerts last after precision/net-attention gates; keep EISV underneath. Required exit rights: one-call bypass, portable export, substitute-compatible interfaces, typed degraded absence, attributable/suppressible alerts, no silent measurement→actuation. Claude host-adapter agreed on reversibility/outage tests but proposed orchestration first; live invocation evidence (plan-only response, timeout, then 27s success) and current telemetry argue against that ranking. Reply with substantive objections or hidden constraints using response_to.
